Record Class PulsarConsumerInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.controlpanel.panels.pulsar.PulsarConsumerInfo
Record Components:
id - the consumer id in the consumer registry
topic - the topic, or the topics the consumer subscribes to
subscription - the subscription name
consumerName - the consumer name
connected - whether the consumer is connected to the broker
paused - whether the consumer is paused
received - the messages received
acknowledged - the acknowledgements sent
failed - the messages that could not be received
public record PulsarConsumerInfo(String id, String topic, String subscription, String consumerName, boolean connected, boolean paused, long received, long acknowledged, long failed) extends Record
A Pulsar consumer. Internal to the Pulsar panel views.
Since:
2.3.0
Author:
Álvaro Sánchez-Mariscal

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:

      Returns:
